question: Should pending Skill Workshop approval prompts be permanently bound to the proposal version shown to the operator, so a later revision invalidates the old approval rather than applying the revised proposal?
rationale: The implementation is deliberate and user-safety motivated, but it changes a previously Proposal-ID-only pending-approval workflow; choosing fail-closed behavior versus preserving old approval semantics is a product and compatibility decision.

options.title: Adopt reviewed-version binding
options.body: Keep the fail-closed behavior so an operator must review and approve the current proposal version after any revision.

options.title: Preserve prior pending approvals
options.body: Keep pending approval prompts Proposal-ID-only and limit version binding to an explicitly introduced opt-in contract.

options.title: Pause for approval-flow design
options.body: Defer merge until maintainers define whether stale approvals should be invalidated, refreshed, or handled through another operator recovery path.

recommendation.title: Adopt reviewed-version binding
recommendation.body: Keep the fail-closed behavior so an operator must review and approve the current proposal version after any revision.
